title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer

Autonomy and Influence : Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate. title: Senior Sales Manager & Team Lead, EMEA (m/f/x)
description: UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world's leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager & Team Lead, EMEA  (m/f/x) to join our Sales team in Berlin (hybrid) or remotely in Germany. Our EMEA team is growing into large European enterprises, and our enterprise go-to-market is still maturing. In this role you sell to those enterprises yourself, and you coach our Sales Managers in the region. Most of your results will come from your own sales, and you will work closely with Marketing and Customer Success teams. What you will do: Drive strategic pipeline and account growth with large European enterprises in energy, finance, insurance and infrastructure. Win and grow strategic enterprise opportunities with our Earth Observation platform. Build relationships with some of Europe's largest enterprise accounts. Deliver your annual sales targets with a healthy and repeatable enterprise pipeline. Coach and mentor your team members, and help them capture and manage complex enterprise opportunities. Improve deal quality, deal progression and forecasting across the EMEA team. Strengthen enterprise selling discipline as our enterprise go-to-market matures. Here is a good summary of what we are looking for: Significant years of sales experience within the geospatial industry, including Earth observation, remote sensing, GIS platform sales, satellite imagery, LiDAR, or adjacent technologies Proven success selling data and/or platforms into enterprise customers, including managing long sales cycles and complex buying committees Enterprise sales experience in the European market Strong track record of sourcing, structuring, and closing high-value deals while carrying and consistently achieving quota Willingness to act as player-coach and to mentor others Ability to guide and develop experienced sellers Track record of planning pipeline and delivering deals in line with forecast Knowledge of remote sensing and geospatial markets in Europe, with vertical expertise in energy, finance, insurance or infrastructure Bonus points if you bring: Team management experience Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice: Let's disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective. Let's stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year. Let's win as a team: We're an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment. Let's be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few. Let's enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year.
